sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-HA cross-linking of CLEC12A-HA on HEK-293T cells induces downstream signaling (L4); surface internalization following cross-linking confirmed by flow cytometry on HeLa cells (L2); tag does not interfere with CLEC12A expression (L4).
sites.rationale: CLEC12A is a type II transmembrane receptor with its C-terminus (residues 63–265) entirely extracellular; the C-terminal residue is A265 (verified in code: seq[264]='A'). L3 explicitly states the HA tag was placed at the C-terminus, pinning insert_after_residue=265 without ambiguity. The tag is 203 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of the ≥3-residue constraint. Multiple independent experiments (L2, L4, L5, L6) confirm surface display by anti-HA staining on intact cells and functional signaling upon cross-linking, satisfying both surface and function criteria. L3 (PMC8508511) explicitly states 'added a HA tag at the C-terminus' of full-length CLEC12A to track expression and induce clustering; L4 (PMC8508511) and L5/L6 (PMC8256872) confirm the same CLEC12A-HA construct is surface-displayed on HEK-293T cells and cross-linkable with anti-HA antibody on intact (non-permeabilized) cells.

sources.claim: We substituted the cysteines with alanines and added a HA tag at the C-terminus to track their expression and to induce CLEC12A clustering.

literature_notes: L1, L2, L4, L5, L6 all report the same CLEC12A-HA construct and confirm surface display and signaling; L3 is chosen as the primary supporting clip because it is the only line that explicitly names the C-terminus as the tag position. L7 reports FLAG-CLEC12A cloned in-frame downstream of an mCherry-P2A sequence in a lentiviral vector; the 'FLAG-' prefix convention places the FLAG tag at the N-terminus of CLEC12A, which is intracellular (residues 1–41 per topology landmarks), so this construct does not qualify as an extracellular surface-tag site and is recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: FLAG-CLEC12A places the FLAG tag at the CLEC12A N-terminus, which is intracellular (residues 1–41 per topology); not a surface-accessible site.
